original.closure_text: Case Closed. Closed date : 2018-07-25 08:25:21.017 Case Resolved Dear Constituent The Boston Public Works Construction Inspection Unit (CIU) has contacted N.Grid and ordered that the sinkhole be investigated and repaired under our sinkhole repair guidelines. Because of dig safe requirements the repair may have to wait a few days. The permiteee is responsible to place a temporary repair until then NOTE: Because National Grid is on strike repairs are taking loner than usual. They are only doing emergencies... we have told N.Grid the City considers this an emergency and want the repair prioritized The location has been added to our database that tracks sinkholes. The CIU Inspector will monitor the progress of the repair. For any questions or concerns please contact the number listed below Sincerely Mark Cardarelli Supervisor of Utility Coordination and Compliance Boston Public Works Department <PHONE> Office
